name: get_character
description: Retrieve detailed information about a character from the knowledge base in a specific canon. Returns the character's name, aliases, bio, and source URLs. Returns null if the character doesn't exist in the specified canon. Use this before updating a character or to check what information we already have.

name.description: Exact character name to look up (e.g., 'Aang', 'Katara')

canon.description: Canon to look up the character in (e.g., 'main', 'film', 'legends')
